profile_text.body:
Hut 8 Corp. describes itself as owning, operating, and scaling purpose-built businesses that acquire, deploy, and monetize specialized hardware for next-generation, energy-intensive technologies. Through that portfolio, the company says it provides direct exposure to markets created by transformative technologies such as AI and Bitcoin mining.

On the AI infrastructure side, the company says it has fully commercialized a 1 GW Beacon Point AI data center campus with a second 352 MW IT lease, bringing campus-level base-term contract value to $19.6 billion. No individual AI products or MCP servers are listed for the company.

Hut 8 is a public company traded under the ticker HUT, with CIK 0001964789, and is headquartered in Miami, Florida. Its legal exposure is listed in Florida, with 96 matters, and no individual cases are named.
